disconnected: The interface has disconnected. Return to the PS5 home screen. To open it again, start HLDRIVE through your homebrew environment.
supportHint: Chip in and help improve the project.
youtubeQR: QR code to subscribe to the YouTube channel
financialQR: QR code to support the creator financially
heroAlt: HLDRIVE — your files in the cloud and on your console
subtitle: Google Drive · PS5 files
controls: D-pad: navigate · ✕: select · ◯: close dialog · Text fields: browser keyboard
stopDescription: Stops the payload and disconnects this interface. Keeps the shortcut, settings and all downloads. To use it again, run the ELF through your loader.
removeDescription: Removes the shortcut, the HLDRIVE.elf copy in the configured folder and the entire /data/HLDRIVE folder, including downloads and settings stored there. Files outside the HLDRIVE folder are kept.
shortcutDescription: Registers the HLDRIVE shortcut on PS5. It opens this interface while HLDRIVE is running; after restarting the console, start the ELF again through your homebrew environment.
added: Transfer added to the PS5 queue.
intro: Listing and downloading happen directly on PS5. Share the Drive folder with “Anyone with the link”.
busy: The Drive connection is dedicated to the current queue. Remote browsing resumes when it finishes.
keepBoth: Keep both with a different name
name: Name
empty: No regular files or subfolders found.
emptyQueue: Select files from Drive and choose where to save them on the console.
queueHint: Downloads continue when switching screens. Recreate the queue after restarting the payload. Interrupted downloads restart from the beginning; completed files remain at the destination.
copied: Items copied: {count}. Use “Paste to console” to choose the destination.
listingHint: Items: {count}. Folders are copied with their structure. “Skip” reuses existing folders and keeps their files without comparing content. Native Google documents are not exported.
